title:
Pull the architecture
apart.
caption:
Separate the layers into a named resource inventory.
Open a subsystem to follow its internal connections.
label: EXPLODED ARCHITECTURE

title:
Every request starts
with identity.
caption:
Authenticated APIs and signed webhooks turn incoming work
into an owner-scoped request.
label: 01 / INGRESS

title:
Durable work.
One Session at a time.
caption:
Agents, Sessions, input receipts and a durable outbox
keep work coordinated.
label: 02 / COORDINATION

title:
Inside the
isolated runtime.
caption:
An isolated EC2 or MicroVM worker runs Codex or Pi Durable.
Declared tools and approved models stay inside fixed access.
label: 03 / EXECUTION

title:
The worker ends.
The work stays.
caption:
Saved history and artifacts outlive the worker.
Workspace handoff requires a committed checkpoint.
label: 04 / DURABLE STATE

title:
Fixed boundaries.
Autonomous execution.
caption:
Profiles, runtime policy and host-side credentials define
the boundary. A Run cannot widen its own authority.
label: 05 / ACCESS BOUNDARY

title:
Connected accounts.
Granted operations.
caption:
Trusted plugins, account grants and authorization
determine which connected tools are available.
label: 06 / CONNECTED SERVICES

title:
Committed state.
Delivered results.
caption:
Saved root Turns drive delivery through the outbox.
Delivery fencing prevents blind retries of uncertain writes.
label: 07 / DELIVERY

title:
Recovery is
part of the system.
caption:
State transitions, reconciliation and heartbeats
repair missed wake-ups and reconcile worker state.
label: 08 / RECOVERY

caption:

An illustrated request path through the actual explorer.
